origin: Fartcoin was launched anonymously on Pump.fun, riding the 'fartcoin' joke promoted by the AI agent Truth Terminal; it was not created by the bot or its developer.
trigger_event: Truth Terminal (Andy Ayrey's AI agent) promoted the Fartcoin idea and was sent tokens, then the bot's holdings rally was widely reported.
notes: AI vs culture/meme fit about equally (fart-joke meme, AI-agent trigger); settled by rule: primary = what triggered the run (Truth Terminal AI agent). Jupiter shows pump.fun launch 2024-10-18 06:05 UTC and DexScreener Raydium pair 2024-10-18 06:09 UTC. These are launch times, not origin_date. @FartCoinOfSOL verified: DexScreener socials link it and X lookup shows it (created 2024-10-18, ~83k followers). @truth_terminal from the listed sources and two third-party X posts (DeFiTracer, TechLeviathan) tying the token to Truth Terminal; an X search for Truth Terminal posts about fartcoin in Oct 2024 returned nothing, so that tie is not confirmed from its own posts.

origin: Anonymous Pump.fun token named for Peanut the Squirrel, a pet squirrel seized and euthanized by New York authorities along with raccoon Fred. Not created by owner Mark Longo.
trigger_event: Public outrage and viral attention after the seizure/euthanasia, amplified by Elon Musk posts.
notes: news event vs animal fit equally; rule: primary = the trigger of the run (the seizure news). Jupiter pump.fun launch 2024-10-31 14:21 UTC and DexScreener Raydium pair 2024-10-31 15:06 UTC These are launch times, not origin_date. @pnutsolana verified: DexScreener socials link it and X lookup shows it (bio 'In memory of Peanut', ~65k followers; account created 2024-08-25, before the seizure news, so it may not be the first Pnut-related account). @elonmusk from a third-party X post saying he shilled it and from the listed sources, not from his own post.
